Package ink.icoding.marginalia.autoconfigure.controller

Class WebController

java.lang.Object
ink.icoding.marginalia.autoconfigure.controller.WebController
@RestController public class WebController extends Object
REST controller for Marginalia Web UI and API. All endpoints are prefixed with the configured path (default: /marginalia/).
